root_cause_accuracy.description: Compare AI final_hypothesis root cause against ground_truth.root_cause
root_cause_accuracy.scoring: 1 if exact category match, 0 if wrong category
root_cause_accuracy.expected_baseline: NULL_DOWNSTREAM incidents should be >90% accurate (deterministic FLS/CDC checks). VALUE_MISMATCH and ambiguous types will be lower.

confidence_calibration.description: For each confidence bucket (0.5-0.6, 0.6-0.7, 0.7-0.8, 0.8-0.9, 0.9-1.0), check if actual accuracy matches stated confidence
confidence_calibration.expected: System should be well-calibrated on NULL_DOWNSTREAM (high confidence, high accuracy) and appropriately uncertain on VALUE_MISMATCH

hypothesis_efficiency.description: Did system take the minimum path to the answer?
hypothesis_efficiency.formula: efficiency = incidents where len(hypotheses_tested) <= ground_truth.min_hypotheses_needed / total
hypothesis_efficiency.notes: Early termination on FLS/CDC confirmation is the key signal

bert_score.description: Semantic similarity between AI root_cause_summary and ground_truth.reference_explanation
bert_score.notes: Run: from bert_score import score; P, R, F1 = score(candidates, references, lang='en')

cross_object_consistency.description: For incidents with identical patterns on different objects (BM-001/BM-008, BM-022/BM-027/BM-030), AI should produce identical root cause categories
cross_object_consistency.test: Group by (discrepancy_type, root_cause, field_pattern) and check variance in confidence scores across objects

deployment_correlation_detection.description: For BM-003 and BM-032, AI should mention deployment correlation in root_cause_summary
deployment_correlation_detection.test: Check if 'deployment' or 'deploy' appears in root_cause_summary for deployment_correlated=true incidents
